description: This file is a test script for the Cable Modem Hardware Abstraction Layer (cmhal). It uses the tdklib library to load the module, invoke the API docsis_GetUSChannel, and validate the upstream channel ID and type. The script loads the module, runs the API, and checks if the channel ID and type follow expected logic, then unloads the module.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: A wrapper class for TDK test library that provides methods for loading modules, creating test steps, executing tests, and retrieving results.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step instance for invoking specific HAL APIs or test functions.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds input parameters to the test step, such as API interface names or parameters.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test case and updates the result status based on API response.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the test execution, such as SUCCESS or FAILURE.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed output or data from the test execution, used for validation.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the final result status of the test case execution.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Indicates whether the module was successfully loaded or failed.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Sets up the test environment with box IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Checks if the module was loaded successfully before proceeding.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads the module after test execution.
